Human.meta: Ancestry constellation • Presence (Medium • 8 HP • 25 ft • bonus to Aid)
Human.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Humanity
nodes.effect: You gain a +1 status bonus on checks to Aid. If you are Expert in Human, this becomes a +2 status bonus. If you are Master, +3. If you are Legendary, +4.
nodes.desc: Short lives teach humans to close ranks and pull together.

nodes.name: Driven
nodes.effect: You gain a Calling Talent Point.
nodes.desc: You were raised to reach, and you have not stopped reaching since.

nodes.name: Quick Study
nodes.effect: You gain a Skill Talent Point.
nodes.desc: Your adaptability shows in how fast you pick up useful skills.

nodes.name: Stubborn Footing
nodes.effect: The first time each encounter you would be knocked prone, you are not.

nodes.name: Close Ranks
nodes.effect: While an ally is adjacent to you, both of you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Guard for physical Attacks.

nodes.name: Versatile Human
nodes.effect: You gain 1 Opening Talent Point.
nodes.desc: Some humans refuse to be one thing; you are a whole toolbox wearing boots.

nodes.name: Jack of Trades
nodes.effect: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Untrained checks.
nodes.desc: You have done a little of everything, and it shows.

nodes.name: Torchbearer Human
nodes.effect: Allies within 15 feet gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their first Defense roll each round while they can see or hear you.
nodes.desc: Some humans carry the light everyone else steers by.

nodes.name: Steady the Line ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger An adjacent ally is Grazed.
Effect No zone of theirs becomes Exposed. Once per round.
nodes.desc: Your voice finds the one who is faltering.

Ambusher.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Sneak Attack
nodes.effect:
You become Trained in Stealth.
You gain Sneak Attack: +1d6 precision damage vs. Off-Guard foes.
Rises to +2d6 at Expert rank, +3d6 at Master, +4d6 at Legendary.

nodes.name: Surprise Attacker
nodes.effect: In the first round, foes that haven't acted yet are Wrong-Footed to you.

nodes.name: Opportunist ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger An ally Hits a creature within your reach.
Effect Strike that creature. It is Off-Guard to this Strike. Once per round.

nodes.name: Twist the Blade
nodes.effect: Once per turn, when your Sneak Attack damage applies to a Hit, the Zone it landed on becomes Exposed.

nodes.name: Bleeding Wound
nodes.effect: When your Sneak Attack damage applies, the target also takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage. This rises to 1d6 at Expert rank, 1d8 at Master, and 1d10 at Legendary.

nodes.name: Unbalancing Blow
nodes.effect: Whenever your Strike is a critical hit and deals damage, the target is Wrong-Footed against your attacks until the end of your next turn.

Berserker.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Rage ◆
nodes.effect:
You become Trained in Athletics.
You gain the Rage action:
Rage ◆ Duration 10 rounds
You gain Temp HP = level + Might, +2 melee damage, −1 Evade. While raging, you are Heedless.
Afterward, you're fatigued until you spend three actions to catch your breath.
You may end your Rage as a free action, becoming fatigued as though it had run its course.
Damage bonus rises to +4 melee damage at Expert rank, +6 at Master, +8 at Legendary.

nodes.name: Sudden Charge ◆◆
nodes.effect:
You gain Sudden Charge:
Sudden Charge ◆◆
Stride twice, then Strike.

nodes.name: Thick Hide
nodes.effect: While you are Raging, every Zone on you has +1 Protection, including Zones with no armor at all. An Exposed Zone still counts as 0.

nodes.name: Blood in the Water
nodes.effect: When your Strike drops a creature while you are Raging, your Rage's remaining duration resets to 10 rounds.

nodes.name: Deaf to Pain
nodes.effect: You ignore the Fatigued condition while Raging, and when your Rage ends you need to spend only 1 action to catch your breath rather than 3.

nodes.name: Moment of Clarity ◇
nodes.effect:
Frequency once per encounter
You push back your rage for a moment in order to think clearly. Until the end of this turn, you lose your Heedless condition.

Bravo.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Panache
nodes.effect:
You become Trained in Acrobatics.
You gain Panache whenever you critically succeed on a Strike, or when you successfully Feint or Demoralize.
You can hold one Panache at a time and you keep it until you spend it or the encounter ends (whichever happens first).
While you have Panache you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Evade and a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds. At Expert rank, the Speed bonus increases to 10 feet. At Master rank, your Evade bonus increases to +2. At Legendary rank, your Speed bonus increases to 15 feet.
Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Finisher ◆
nodes.effect:
Spend your Panache and Strike, with the following effects:
Hit add 2d6 precision damage.
Graze add 1d6 precision damage.
You lose the Panache either way.

nodes.name: Opportune Parry ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger A creature Grazes or Misses you while you have Panache.
Effect You do not pay the Graze cost.

nodes.name: Nimble Recovery
nodes.effect: While you have Panache, you may Recenter as a free action once per turn.

nodes.name: Bravo's Entrance
nodes.effect: You begin every encounter with Panache if you are not surprised.

nodes.name: Elegant Buckler
nodes.effect:
When you Raise a Shield ◆ to gain a circumstance bonus to Guard from a buckler, increase the bonus from +1 to +2.
While you have a buckler raised, if a creature critically misses you with a Strike, you gain Panache.

nodes.name: Extravagant Parry ◆
nodes.effect:
Requirements You're wielding one or more one-handed weapons.
You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Guard until the start of your next turn, or a +2 circumstance bonus if you have a free hand or are wielding a weapon with the Parry trait. You lose this circumstance bonus if you no longer meet this talent's requirement. If a creature misses you with a Strike while you have this bonus, you gain Panache.

Hunter.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Mark Prey ◆
nodes.effect:
You become Trained in Awareness.
(Concentrate) Choose one creature you can see. It is your prey until you Mark another or the encounter ends.
The first time each round that you Hit your prey, add 1d8 precision damage. You also always know roughly where your prey is while it is within 60 feet, even while it is Hidden or Undetected. The extra precision damage rises to 2d8 at Expert rank, 3d8 at Master, and 4d8 at Legendary.
Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Running Mark
nodes.effect: You may Mark Prey as part of a Stride rather than spending an action.

nodes.name: Read the Quarry
nodes.effect: The first time each encounter your prey attacks you, you learn if its Evade or Guard is higher.

nodes.name: Hobbling Strike
nodes.effect: When you Hit your prey with the first Strike of your turn, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

nodes.name: No Escape ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger Your prey Strides away from you.
Effect Stride up to your Speed toward it. This does not provoke reactions from your prey.

nodes.name: Hunter's Aim ◆◆
nodes.effect: Make a weapon Strike against your Marked Prey. On this Strike, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignore your prey's concealed condition and any lesser cover.

Weaponmaster.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Drilled
nodes.effect:
You become Trained in Athletics.
You gain the Weapon Familiarity Talent for free.
Choose one Weapon Group in which you are Familiar. When making attacks with weapons of that Group, treat your Weapons Proficiency Bonus as 2 higher. This does not actually increase your Proficiency Rank and does not satisfy Expert, Master, or Legendary prerequisites.
You may take the Reactive Strike Talent, ignoring its requirements. However, you may still only use Reactive Strike ↺ with weapons in which you are at least Expert Proficiency Rank.
Every Talent in this Constellation requires this.

nodes.name: Hold the Line
nodes.effect: Your Reactive Strike ↺ also triggers when a creature within your reach uses a Move action.

nodes.name: Punishing Blow
nodes.effect: Your Reactive Strike disrupts the triggering action on a Hit, if the Zone struck was Exposed.

nodes.name: Second Nature
nodes.effect: Your weapon specialization damage arrives one rank early with your Drilled group: +2 while Trained, +3 at Expert, +4 at Master, +5 at Legendary.

nodes.name: Hold Fast
nodes.effect: When a Graze would Expose one of your Zones, you may take 1 damage per level and Expose nothing instead.

Archery.meta: Combat Style • Agility (bows and careful ranged attacks)
Archery.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Archery Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Draw a Bead ◆ action.
Draw a Bead ◆ (concentrate)
Choose one creature you can Observe and can reach with your bow.
Until the end of your turn: your next bow Strike against that creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack; ignore the weapon's Unwieldy penalty for that Strike; if that Strike Grazes, you choose the Zone that becomes Exposed instead of the defender. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Clear the Line
nodes.effect: Your ranged attacks treat Lesser Cover as no Cover.

nodes.name: Loose and Move
nodes.effect: After making a Strike with a bow, you may Step 3 feet as a free action once per turn.

nodes.name: Close Shot
nodes.effect: Reduce the Unwieldy distance of your bow by 5 feet. If that would reduce it to 0, the weapon no longer has Unwieldy for you.

Armored Fighting.meta: Combat Style • Presence (the harness as a weapon)
Armored Fighting.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Armored Fighting Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
When determining whether your armor forms a complete harness for an Armored Fighting Talent, all four Zones must be armored in the required material. If you are Master, only three Zones must be armored in the required material. Every talent here requires this.
nodes.desc: Knowing how to exploit armor as part of your fighting method.

nodes.name: Ironclad
nodes.effect: While wearing Full Plate, gain a +1 status bonus to Guard for physical Attacks against Shove, Trip, and Reposition.
nodes.desc: You're not harder to hit generally. You're harder to move.

nodes.name: Trust the Harness
nodes.effect: While wearing Full Plate, when you would choose an armored Zone for a Graze, you may choose the Torso even if another rule would normally require another Zone.

nodes.name: Lock Down ◆
nodes.effect:
You settle your weight into your Full Plate harness.
While in this Stance: +1 status bonus to Guard for physical Attacks; you cannot be forcibly moved more than 3 feet by a single effect unless it critically succeeds; your Speed is reduced by 5 feet.

nodes.name: Punishing Shove
nodes.effect: When you successfully Shove a creature, that creature takes an amount of bludgeoning damage equal to your Might modifier (or double that amount on a Critical Success). This damage increases by 2 when you become Expert in Armored Fighting, 6 when you become Master, and 12 when you become Legendary.
nodes.desc: When you push a foe away, you put the entire force of your Full Plate harness into it.

nodes.name: Shoulder Check ◆
nodes.effect:
You hit a foe with your armor to throw them off balance. Make a fist Strike even if you don't have a hand free; if you're wielding a gauntlet or spiked gauntlet, you can make a Strike with one of those weapons instead. The Strike gains the following additional results:
Critical Success The target is Wrong-Footed for you until the end of your next turn.
Success The target is Wrong-Footed for you against the next Attack you attempt against it before the end of your current turn.
Critical Failure You are Wrong-Footed against melee attacks the target attempts against you until the end of your next turn.

nodes.name: Flowing Defense ◆
nodes.effect:
Flowing Defense ◆ (stance)
While wearing Full Mail: when you Recenter, you may also Step 3 feet; −1 status penalty to Guard for physical Attacks versus Shove; retains mail's normal vulnerability to piercing.

nodes.name: Supple Harness
nodes.effect: Your first Step each turn ignores 1 point of Load Strain's effect on movement-related checks.

nodes.name: Roll With It ↺
nodes.effect: When you are Grazed while wearing Full Mail, you may Step 3 feet after resolving the attack and damage.

nodes.name: Turn the Scales ↺
nodes.effect: Once per round when you would be Hit, shift the blow to another armored, non-Exposed Zone.

nodes.name: Layered Guard ◆
nodes.effect:
Layered Guard ◆ (stance)
While wearing Full Scale: the first time each round a Zone becomes Exposed, another Zone of your choice gains +1 Protection until the start of your next turn.

nodes.name: Loose Guard
nodes.effect: While all four Zones are Padded or Leather and your Load Strain is 0, Recenter lets you Step 3 feet as part of the action.

nodes.name: Light on Your Feet ◆
nodes.effect:
Light on Your Feet ◆ (stance)
While in light armor: +1 status bonus to Evade for physical Attacks; after a creature Misses you, Step 3 feet once per round. Cannot be used if your Load Strain exceeds 0.

Brawling.meta: Combat Style • Might (fists, feet, tusks, headbutts)
Brawling.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Brawling Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency. Every talent here requires this.
You gain the Clinch action.
Clinch ◆ (stance) While you are in this stance, when you Graze an enemy with a Strike, you choose which of its Zones is Exposed, rather than the enemy. At Master rank, a creature you have Grabbed cannot Recenter.

nodes.name: Iron Fists
nodes.effect: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 and count as weapons (lethal by default, your choice).

nodes.name: Snagging Grip ◆
nodes.effect: Strike with a free hand; on a hit, the target is Off-Guard until your next turn.

nodes.name: Crushing Grab
nodes.effect: When you successfully Grapple a creature, you can deal bludgeoning damage to that creature equal to your Might bonus. You can make this attack nonlethal with no penalty.

Crossbow Fighting.meta: Combat Style • Wits (prepared mechanical ranged weapons)
Crossbow Fighting.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Crossbow Fighting Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Brace the Stock ◆ action.
Brace the Stock ◆ (stance)
You settle into a firing position. Until you Move: gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all crossbow Strikes; increase any Armor-Piercing [N] value of those attacks by 1; if the attack Grazes, you choose the Zone that becomes Exposed. The effect ends after you make a Move. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Practiced Loader
nodes.effect: Once per turn, reduce the Reload value of a crossbow by 1, to a minimum of 1.

nodes.name: Crank and Move
nodes.effect: When you spend an action Reloading, you may Step 3 feet as part of that action.

nodes.name: Find the Seam
nodes.effect: Your Crossbow Strikes do an additional 2 damage against Exposed Zones.

nodes.name: Snap Shot
nodes.effect: You may use a loaded crossbow with the Close trait to make Reactive Strikes if you have an ability that grants them.

nodes.name: Covered Reload ◆
nodes.effect: Take Cover, then Interact to reload. As normal, you must meet the requirements to Take Cover.

Dueling.meta: Combat Style • Agility (one one-handed weapon, other hand free)
Dueling.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Dueling Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency. Every talent here requires this.
You gain the Measure action.
The Measure ◆ (stance) You must wield a single one-handed weapon with your other hand free. Name one creature as you enter the stance. That creature must answer your Strikes with the same Defense it used against your previous Strike, until you leave the stance or name another. At Master rank you may name a new creature as a free action.

nodes.name: En Garde
nodes.effect: +1 circumstance Guard vs. melee while wielding a one-handed weapon with your other hand free.

nodes.name: Feinting Lunge ◆◆
nodes.effect: Feint, Strike, then Step.

nodes.name: Snagging Strike ◆
nodes.effect: You combine an attack with quick grappling moves to throw an enemy off balance as long as it stays in your reach. Make a Strike while keeping one hand free. If this Strike hits, the target is Off-Guard until the start of your next turn or until it's no longer within the reach of your hand, whichever comes first.

nodes.name: Combat Grab ◆
nodes.effect:
Press
Requirements You have one hand free, and your target is within reach of that hand.
Using your prior attack to shift your opponent's guard, you take another swing and grab them. Make a melee Strike while keeping one hand free. If the Strike hits, you grab the target using your free hand. The creature remains grabbed until the end of your next turn or until it Escapes, whichever comes first.

nodes.name: Dueling Parry ◆
nodes.effect:
Requirements You are wielding a single one-handed melee weapon and hold nothing else in your hands.
You can parry attacks against you with your one-handed weapon. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Guard until the start of your next turn as long as you continue to meet the requirements.

Great Weapon Fighting.meta: Combat Style • Might (two hands, full commitment)
Great Weapon Fighting.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Great Weapon Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Overreach action.
Overreach ◆ (stance)
You must be wielding a two-handed melee weapon.
While you are in this stance your Hits and Critical Hits deal +2 damage and your Evade drops by 2, rising to +3 damage at Expert rank, +4 at Master, and +5 at Legendary. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Sweeping Blow ◆◆
nodes.effect: One attack roll against two creatures within your reach, resolved separately against each one's chosen Defense. Both count as a single attack for your multiple attack penalty.

nodes.name: Follow Through
nodes.effect: When your Strike drops a creature, your next Strike this turn ignores your multiple attack penalty.

nodes.name: Brutish Shove ◆
nodes.effect:
Requirements You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.
Using the momentum of your last attack to throw your weight into another, you make your opponent stumble back. Make a Strike with a two-handed melee weapon. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, that creature is Off-Guard until the end of your current turn, and you can automatically Shove it, with the same benefits as the Shove action (including the Critical Success effect, if your Strike was a Critical Hit). If you move to follow the target, your movement doesn't trigger reactions.
Failure The target becomes Off-Guard until the end of your current turn.

nodes.name: Crushing Commitment
nodes.effect: When you make a Strike ◆◆◆ with a two-handed weapon, deal one extra weapon die of damage.

nodes.name: Devastating Graze
nodes.effect: If you Strike and it results in a Graze, you add your Might bonus to the damage.

Missile Skirmishing.meta: Combat Style • Agility (slings, thrown weapons, bolas)
Missile Skirmishing.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Missile Skirmishing Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Keep Moving ◆ action.
Keep Moving ◆ (stance)
Requirements You wield a sling or a weapon with the Thrown trait.
While in this stance: if you make a ranged Strike, you may Step 3 feet immediately before or after it; you may use this benefit only once per turn. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Quick Hand
nodes.effect: Draw a thrown weapon as part of the Strike made with it.

nodes.name: Running Cast
nodes.effect: If you Strided at least 5 feet immediately before making a ranged Strike with a sling or thrown weapon, increase its Range by 10 feet for that Strike.

nodes.name: Harrying Shot
nodes.effect: When you Graze with a sling or thrown weapon, the target takes a −1 circumstance penalty to its next Attack before the end of its next turn.

nodes.name: Trip Line
nodes.effect: You get a +2 status bonus to your Trip checks when using a Ranged weapon with the Trip trait.

nodes.name: Rebounding Toss ◆◆
nodes.effect:
Requirements You are wielding a thrown weapon.
You bounce your weapon off one foe to strike another. Make a ranged Strike with a thrown weapon. If this Strike hits, the weapon rebounds toward an enemy within 10 feet of the original target. Make an additional Strike against this second target. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both attacks.

Shield Fighting.meta: Combat Style • Presence (weapon and shield as one machine)
Shield Fighting.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Shield Fighting Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency. Every talent here requires this.
You gain the Shield Wall action.
Shield Wall ◆ (stance) You must be wielding a shield. While you are in this stance your shield counts as Raised at all times, without spending an action for it, but you cannot Stride; you may only Step. At Master rank you may Stride up to half your Speed while the stance holds.

nodes.name: Reactive Shield ↺
nodes.effect: When attacked, Raise your Shield.

nodes.name: Shield Block ↺
nodes.effect: Reduce an attack's damage to you by your shield's hardness.

nodes.name: Aggressive Block ◇
nodes.effect:
Trigger You use Shield Block ↺, and the opponent that triggered Shield Block is adjacent to you and is your size or smaller.
You push back as you block, knocking your foe away or off balance. You use your shield to push the triggering creature, either automatically Shoving it 5 feet or causing it to become Off-Guard until the start of your next turn. The triggering creature chooses whether to be moved or become Off-Guard. If it chooses to be moved, you choose the direction. If the Shove would cause it to hit a solid object or enter another creature's space, it must become Off-Guard instead of being moved.

nodes.name: Devoted Guardian ◆
nodes.effect:
Requirements Your last action was to Raise a Shield.
You adopt a wide stance, ready to defend both yourself and your chosen ward. Select one adjacent creature. As long as your shield is raised and the creature remains adjacent to you, the creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their Guard, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the shield you raised was a tower shield.

nodes.name: Defensive Advance ◆◆
nodes.effect:
Flourish
With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle. You Raise your Shield and Stride. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. You can use Defensive Advance while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

nodes.name: Shield Warfare
nodes.effect: You know how to use shields offensively far better than most. Increase the weapon damage die of any shield bash, shield boss, or shield spikes you wield by one step.

Spear & Polearm Fighting.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Spear & Polearm Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Keep Measure ◆ action.
Keep Measure ◆ (stance)
Requirements You are wielding a hafted weapon.
While in this stance: the first time each round an enemy moves from outside your Reach into it, you may Step 3 feet directly away as a free action after that movement finishes; if that movement keeps the enemy within your Reach, it does not trigger reactions from that enemy. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Set Against the Charge ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger A creature moves into your reach.
Effect Strike it. If it entered from outside your reach, your weapon deals +2 damage per weapon die.

nodes.name: Short Grip Strike ◆
nodes.effect:
Flourish
Requirements You are wielding a hafted weapon.
Reduce your weapon's Unwieldy value by 2 ft.

nodes.name: Long Haft
nodes.effect: Increase hafted weapon Reach by 2 ft while using two hands.

nodes.name: Keep Away
nodes.effect: If you Attack a foe and it results in a Graze, you may Step instead of Exposing a Zone.

nodes.name: Sleek Reposition ◆
nodes.effect:
Press
While your opponent is still recovering from your prior attack, you snag its armor, clothing, or flesh to move it as you please. Make a melee Strike with a spear or polearm. If you hit a target that is your size or smaller, you can automatically Reposition it, with the same benefits as the Reposition action (including the Critical Success effect, if your Strike was a Critical Hit). Use your Total Reach for this Reposition.
Failure The target becomes Off-Guard until the end of your current turn.

Two-Weapon Fighting.meta: Combat Style • Agility (a weapon in each hand)
Two-Weapon Fighting.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Two-Weapon Fighting Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency. Every talent here requires this.
You gain the Twin Openings action.
Twin Openings ◆ (stance) You must have a weapon in each hand. While you are in this stance, the first time each turn that you hit the same creature with both of your weapons, you may make one of its zones Exposed after resolving the attack and damage.

nodes.name: Double Slice ◆◆
nodes.effect: Strike with each weapon at your current multiple attack penalty; combine the damage for purposes of bypassing Protection.

nodes.name: Off-Hand Guard
nodes.effect: +1 circumstance to Guard while wielding two weapons and not raising a shield.

Serrovane.meta: Culture constellation • Presence (Serrovine + Common; a lowland order-state where nothing is real until written and witnessed)
Serrovane.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Serrovanian
nodes.effect:
You know Serrovine and Common.
You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks toward those who share the same Culture. When you are Expert in your Origin Constellation, the bonus increases to +2. Master: +3. Legendary: +4.

nodes.name: Oathbound
nodes.effect: Name one creature that has broken a bargain, a truce, or a formal challenge with you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Attack rolls and Defense rolls against that creature until the encounter ends. You may have only one Oathbound creature at a time.

nodes.name: Contract Literate
nodes.effect: +2 circumstance to notice hidden clauses, traps, and altered terms in any agreement.
nodes.desc: Read legal, and infernal, contracts at a glance.

nodes.name: Iron Etiquette
nodes.effect: +1 circumstance to checks against Intimidation and social manipulation.

Kestrel Reach.meta: Culture constellation • Wits (Reachspeak + Common; delta trade-towns where a good broker beats a good sword)
Kestrel Reach.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Reacher
nodes.effect:
You know Reachspeak and Common.
You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks toward those who share the same Culture. When you are Expert in your Origin Constellation, the bonus increases to +2. Master: +3. Legendary: +4.

nodes.name: Quick Tongue ◇
nodes.effect:
You gain the Quick Tongue action:
Quick Tongue ◇
Trigger You critically fail a Diplomacy check.
Requirements You're in a settlement or community, and you haven't used Quick Tongue in this settlement or community within the past month.
Reroll the triggering Diplomacy check, using the second result.

nodes.name: Riverfoot
nodes.effect: You ignore difficult terrain from mud, decking, loose stone, and shallow water, and your first Stride each encounter is 5 feet longer.

nodes.name: Broker's Eye
nodes.effect: You always know an item's fair price, and gain +2 circumstance to Diplomacy and Guile checks when trading.

Awareness.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Awareness Training
nodes.effect: You are Trained in Awareness: add this Constellation's Proficiency Bonus to your Awareness checks, and to your Awareness Threshold (the number Sneak, Feint, and Lie attempts are measured against). Initiative is usually an Awareness check.

nodes.name: Forewarned
nodes.effect: Once per encounter, after you roll a Defense but before the outcome is announced, you may add your Wits to that roll.

nodes.name: Read the Tell
nodes.effect: When a creature critically fails to Feint against you, Lie to you, or Sneak past you, it becomes Exposed (Head) until it Recenters.

nodes.name: First Word
nodes.effect: When you roll initiative and are not surprised, you may swap your place in the order with one willing ally.

nodes.name: Second Sense
nodes.effect: The first time each encounter that a hidden or unnoticed creature attacks you, you may use Guard against that attack even though you were unaware of it.

Evade.meta: Defense constellation • Agility (don't be there • Give Ground posture)
Evade.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Evade Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in Evade: add this Constellation's Proficiency Bonus to your Evade checks. It is the number attack rolls are measured against when you try to slip a blow, and the check you roll against area effects, traps, and hazards.
You gain the Give Ground ↺ posture:
You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Evade for the triggering attack.
A Zone of your choice becomes Exposed immediately, win or lose.

nodes.name: Fluid Motion
nodes.effect: Your Speed increases by 5 feet while your Load Strain is 1 or less.

nodes.name: Skirmisher's Step
nodes.effect: Your Steps ignore difficult terrain.

nodes.name: Slip the Line ↺
nodes.effect: (posture) +2 to your Evade against one attack. If the blow does not Hit, you end in any square adjacent to the attacker, your choice.

nodes.name: Drop Flat ↺
nodes.effect: (posture) +4 to your Evade against every attack until the start of your next turn. You end prone.

Guard.meta: Defense constellation • Presence (don't let it through • Set Your Feet posture)
Guard.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Guard Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in Guard: add this Constellation's Proficiency Bonus to your Guard checks. It is the number attack rolls are measured against when you meet a blow with weapon, shield, or braced arm, and the check you roll against fear, charm, confusion, and other assaults on your composure.
You gain the Set Your Feet ↺ posture:
You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Guard for the triggering attack.
A Zone of your choice becomes Exposed immediately, win or lose.

nodes.name: Kneel Behind the Shield ↺
nodes.effect:
(posture) You must have a shield Raised.
+4 to your Guard against every attack until the start of your next turn. Your Arms become Exposed, and your Speed is 0 until you spend an action to rise.

nodes.name: Unshaken
nodes.effect: The first time each encounter that a Graze would Expose a zone on you, it does not.

nodes.name: Deflecting Palms ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger You are hit and have a hand free.
Effect Reduce that attack's damage by 2 plus your Presence.

nodes.name: Cover the Angle ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger An adjacent ally is attacked.
Effect The attack is measured against your Guard instead of their chosen Defense, and any Graze cost falls on you.

nodes.name: Larger than Life
nodes.effect:
Requirements You are wearing Plate in all Zones.
Though you don't get any larger, you're treated as one size larger for the purposes of affecting other creatures with actions like Disarm, Grapple, Reposition, Shove, and Trip while wearing heavy armor. Similarly, you're treated as one size larger for the purposes of creatures affecting you with those same actions, as well as with Swallow Whole and similar actions, while wearing heavy armor.

Endure.meta: Defense constellation • Might (survive what does come through)
Endure.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Endure Training
nodes.effect: You are Trained in Endure: add this Constellation's Proficiency Bonus to your Endure checks. It is the check you roll against poison, disease, exhaustion, and anything trying to break your body. You also reduce your Load Strain by 1 (to a minimum of 0) once you reach Expert rank, 2 at Master, and 3 at Legendary.

nodes.name: Shrug It Off
nodes.effect: Reduce each instance of persistent damage you take by your Might. This can never reduce it below 1.

nodes.name: Second Wind ◆◆
nodes.effect: Once per day, dig deep: regain Hit Points equal to half your level plus your Might.

nodes.name: Braced Frame
nodes.effect: +2 circumstance bonus to your Guard against Shove, Trip, and Reposition.

nodes.name: Blade Brake ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger You would be moved by a forced movement effect.
Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon and are within reach of a hard surface.
You plow your weapon into a floor, wall, or another sturdy surface, anchoring yourself in place. If you would be moved 20 feet or more, you are moved only 5 feet. Otherwise, you don't move at all.

Lore.meta: Skill constellation • Wits (the template every Lore (X) Constellation copies)
Lore.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Deep Knowledge
nodes.effect: You are Trained in this Lore: add the Constellation's rank to its checks. Recall and research within its field; you know its people, texts, and secrets. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Practical Application
nodes.effect: +2 circumstance to any check where you can explain how this field directly applies. The GM is the judge; the story is the proof.

nodes.name: Well Read ◇
nodes.effect: Once per scene, Recall Knowledge about your field as a free action.

Acrobatics.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Acrobatics Training
nodes.effect: You are Trained in this skill: add the Constellation's rank to its checks. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Tumbling Retreat ◆
nodes.effect: Step 6 feet instead of 3. You still cannot Step in Difficult Terrain or Greater Difficult Terrain.

nodes.name: Slip the Grasp
nodes.effect: +2 circumstance bonus to Escape.

nodes.name: Kip Up ◆
nodes.effect: Stand up. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

nodes.name: Kip Away
nodes.effect: When you Stand, you may Step as part of the same action.

nodes.name: Tumble Behind
nodes.effect: When you successfully Tumble Through, the foe whose space you passed through is Wrong-Footed against the next attack you make before the end of your current turn.

nodes.name: Mobility
nodes.effect: When you Stride and move half your Speed or less, that movement does not trigger reactions. You can use Mobility when Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

Athletics.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Athletics Training
nodes.effect: You are Trained in this skill: add the Constellation's rank to its checks. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Bull Rush ◆◆
nodes.effect:
Stride, then Shove.
Add 3 feet to the push for every 10 feet you moved first.

nodes.name: Wrestler's Grip
nodes.effect: A creature you have Grabbed takes a −2 circumstance penalty to Escape.

nodes.name: Titan Wrestler
nodes.effect: Grapple, Shove, and Trip creatures up to two sizes larger than you.

Diplomacy.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Diplomacy Training
nodes.effect: You are Trained in this skill: add the Constellation's rank to its checks. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Rally ◆
nodes.effect:
You gain the Rally ◆ action:
Rally ◆ Auditory, Emotion, Mental
Roll Diplomacy against a Threshold of 14 + your level. On a success, one ally within 30 feet who can hear you gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next Defense roll before the start of your next turn. On a critical success, +2, and they can Recenter ◆ as a free action.

nodes.name: Talk Them Down ◆
nodes.effect:
You gain the Talk Them Down ◆ action:
Talk Them Down ◆ Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, Mental
Roll Diplomacy against the target's Guard. On a success, it takes a −2 circumstance penalty to Attacks against you until the end of your next turn; on a critical success, until the end of the encounter. On a critical failure it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Attacks against you.

nodes.name: Coordinated Effort
nodes.effect: When you Aid an ally, the bonus is +2 instead of +1, and +3 on a critical success.

nodes.name: Command the Field ◆◆
nodes.effect:
You gain the Command the Field ◆◆ action:
Command the Field ◆◆ Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, Mental
Roll Diplomacy against a Threshold of 14 + your level. On a success, two allies who can hear you may each Step as a free action. On a critical success, they may each Stride half their Speed instead.

Guile.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Guile Training
nodes.effect: You are Trained in this skill: add the Constellation's rank to its checks. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Feinting Step ◆
nodes.effect: Feint, then Step.

nodes.name: Sell the Feint
nodes.effect: When you critically succeed at a Feint, the target is Off-Guard to everyone, not just you, until the end of your next turn.

nodes.name: Overextending Feint
nodes.effect:
On a successful Feint, you can use the following success and critical success effects instead of any other effects that would occur when you Feint.
Critical Success The target takes a −2 circumstance penalty to all attack rolls against you before the end of its next turn.
Success The target takes a −2 circumstance penalty to its next attack roll against you before the end of its next turn.

nodes.name: Distracting Feint
nodes.effect: While a creature is Off-Guard or Wrong-Footed by your Feints, it also takes a −2 circumstance penalty to Awareness and Agility checks and Thresholds.

Intimidation.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Intimidation Training
nodes.effect: You are Trained in this skill: add the Constellation's rank to its checks. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Battle Cry ◇
nodes.effect:
Trigger You are about to roll Initiative.
Demoralize every enemy within 15 feet with a single roll, compared separately against each one's Guard.

nodes.name: No Quarter
nodes.effect: When you drop a creature, you may Demoralize one enemy who saw it fall as a free action.

nodes.name: Unnerving
nodes.effect: A creature you have Demoralized this encounter takes a −1 circumstance penalty to attacks against you for the rest of it.

nodes.name: Brutal Beating
nodes.effect: Whenever your Strike is a critical hit and deals damage, the target is Frightened 1.

Stealth.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Stealth Training
nodes.effect: You are Trained in this skill: add the Constellation's rank to its checks. Every talent here requires this.

nodes.name: Knife in the Dark
nodes.effect: When you Hit a creature that is Off-Guard or Wrong-Footed to you, you choose which Zone the blow lands on.

nodes.name: Lost in the Noise ↺
nodes.effect:
Trigger An attack against you Misses.
Effect If you have cover or concealment, Hide as part of this reaction.

nodes.name: Killing Stillness
nodes.effect: The first time each encounter that you Strike a creature that is unaware of you, a Graze becomes a Hit.

nodes.name: Underhanded Assault ◆◆
nodes.effect: You Sneak up to a foe adjacent to one of your allies. You can roll against the foe you're Sneaking up on, even if it's currently observing you, as though you were hidden. You take a −2 penalty on your Stealth check. If your Stealth check against the chosen foe succeeds, you can make a melee Strike against that foe at the end of your Sneak, and they are Wrong-Footed against that Strike.

Weapons.meta: Weapon • Might (transferable fundamentals: measure, timing, footwork, guard)
Weapons.sparks: Crit succeed or crit fail on any roll with consequences, directly related to a talent in this constellation.

nodes.name: Weapons Training
nodes.effect:
You are Trained in weapons: add this Constellation's Proficiency Bonus to your attack rolls with any weapon.
Special Intuitive weapons use your full Weapons Proficiency Bonus. Practiced or Technical weapons do not; see Chapter 5: Equipment for rules on Weapon Handling.

nodes.name: Weapon Familiarity
nodes.effect: Choose a Weapon Group or a Technical weapon. You are Familiar with weapons in that group or that Technical weapon.

nodes.name: Quick Draw
nodes.effect: Use a reaction to draw or stow an item, weapon, or shield in each hand (or in both hands, if it requires two hands).

nodes.name: Turn the Weapon
nodes.effect: You may deal bludgeoning damage with any Familiar melee weapon you wield, striking with the pommel, the haft, or the flat. Its damage die drops one step when you do (d12 to d10 to d8 to d6 to d4).

nodes.name: Sure Grip
nodes.effect: +2 circumstance bonus to your Guard against Disarm regarding a Familiar weapon. When a Disarm against you would succeed, you keep hold of the weapon and suffer only the loosened grip.

nodes.name: Read the Steel ◆
nodes.effect: Study one creature you can see. Until the end of the encounter you know the Protection and the material of each of its Zones, and your Strikes against it ignore 1 Protection.

nodes.name: Reactive Strike ↺
nodes.effect:
You gain the Reactive Strike ↺ reaction.
Reactive Strike ↺
Requirements You are wielding a weapon in which you are at least Expert.
Trigger An Observed creature within your reach begins to use a Manipulate action or Stride.
Effect Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. The Multiple Attack Penalty does not apply; nor does it accrue as a result of this Strike. On a Critical Hit, the triggering action is disrupted: it fails, and any actions still to come in that activity are lost.
